title: UEC Canonical Standard Schema
description:
JSON Schema for the Universal Event Code (UEC) brain artifact (uec-codes.yaml). Validates structure AND declares the brand-promise constraints that the CI gate (OSE-324) enforces computationally.

The schema's job is to reject any UEC artifact whose STRUCTURE is malformed. The CI gate's job is to compute WCAG contrast for every scan_hex and assert it meets the declared wcag_grade. Together they enforce the load-bearing claim that 'the color IS the instruction' remains physically scannable across every code, forever.

schema_version.description: Semver of this schema file itself (not the UEC standard).

provenance.description: Documents where the canonical values came from. Required so future maintainers can trace back to the originating sources.

palette_usage.description: Contract for which surfaces consume which palette. Used by drift checks (OSE-323) to assert consumer surfaces use the correct palette for their job.

verticals.description: Canonical list of event verticals. Each code's verticals[] MUST be a subset of this list. event-taxonomy.yaml MUST also use a subset.

codes.description: The 7 core + 4 extension UEC codes. Order is canonical (core first by num 01-07, then extensions by num 08-11).

changelog.description: Documents v1.0 → v1.1 transitions and any future version transitions. Append-only; never rewrite history.

notes.description: Architectural notes for future maintainers — design decisions, sequencing rationale, edge cases. Free-form but encouraged.

hexColor.description: 6-digit hex color, uppercase or lowercase, with leading #

wcagGrade.description: WCAG contrast grade against white background. FAIL is NOT permitted — the brand promise 'the color IS the instruction' requires every UEC scan_hex to remain physically scannable. CI gate (OSE-324) computes actual contrast and asserts it meets or exceeds this declared grade. WCAG thresholds on white: AA ≥ 4.5:1, AAA ≥ 7:1.

status.description: Change-relative-to-previous-version status. KEEP = unchanged from prior version. ADD = new in this version. CHANGE = modified in this version (color, name, or both — see changelog for detail).

phase.description: Event Triangle phase the code primarily belongs to. Anytime = ambient/utility codes that span phases.

extensionPriority.description: Extension codes only. Indicates operational priority for which verticals/contexts should adopt the extension.

id.description: Code identifier. UPPERCASE with optional hyphens (e.g., ENTER, CHECK-IN). Must be unique across all codes (enforced by CI).

num.description: Two-digit zero-padded sequence number. 01-07 = core; 08+ = extensions. Must be unique across all codes (enforced by CI).

scan_hex.description: QR module fill color. MUST yield WCAG contrast matching declared wcag_grade on white (#FFFFFF). Computed and asserted by CI gate OSE-324.

display_hex.description: UI showcase + marketing color. No contrast requirement, but MUST belong to the same semantic color family as scan_hex (e.g., both ENTER hexes must be recognizably 'green').

semantics.description: Short semantic formula, typically 3 words separated by ' · ' (e.g., 'Go · Access · Safe Passage').

description.description: What the code is used for in plain language. Concrete examples preferred over abstractions.

url_path.description: Human-readable URL path the code resolves to (e.g., '/enter', '/sponsor'). Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens only. No UUIDs.

verticals.description: Subset of top-level verticals[]. Enforces which event verticals this code applies to. Asserted by CI: every value must appear in the top-level verticals list.

data_generated.description: BigQuery / D1 table names this code's scans feed into. Empty array OK for utility codes that don't generate tracking data.

requires_alt_print.description: Optional carve-out marker for codes whose scan_hex fundamentally cannot pass WCAG contrast on white (e.g., ALERT yellow). When true, the WCAG-on-white CI gate (OSE-324, level3_unit.py) SKIPS this code's contrast computation. Codes marking this MUST justify the carve-out in their rationale.verdict, and MUST require alternative print substrate (e.g., yellow background with dark modules) to remain scannable. Defaults to false / absent (most codes follow standard WCAG-on-white).

psychology.description: Color psychology — why this color carries this meaning across cultures.

why.description: Why this code exists in the UEC system. The functional + brand justification.

verdict.description: Editorial summary — 'is this code locked in? what would challenge it?' Used by future maintainers to know which codes are permanent vs. iterable.

then.description: Core codes (01-07) must NOT have extension_priority.

code.description: The code ID this changelog entry affects (e.g., 'ENTER', 'FEEDBACK', 'ALERT').

type.description: Categorical change type. Enables CI/tooling to enumerate breaking vs. non-breaking transitions.

reason.description: Why the change happened. Mandatory for traceability.
